description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to generative AI use in journalism. The chart contains three slices, representing “Article generation,” “Task Type,” and “Headline generation.” The “Article generation” slice is red and occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart, with the percentage displayed directly on the slice. The “Headline generation” slice is yellow and represents approximately 16.8% of the chart, also with a percentage label. The central slice, labeled “Task Type,” is white and does not have a percentage associated with it. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding task type. The slices appear ordered clockwise, with the largest slice positioned first.
